item.title: Alpha School Claims to Teach Kids Twice as Fast. Many Don’t Make It.

item.dc:creator: Dana Goldstein

item.media:description: An Alpha private school in Austin, Texas. The Alpha network is small but growing rapidly. Its leaders have ambitions for the model to reach one billion students around the world.
